title: Uniquely normalized tensor evaluation of strict coefficient towers
statement: Let ℓ and E be as in [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and let R be the lifted integral coefficient ring and ev_n the exact evaluation functor of [def-coef-tower-trace-constructions]. For the pointwise derived tensor of strict R-module towers from [def-coef-tower-evaluation-pairing-constructions], define the canonical comparison δ_n : ev_n(B ⊗ᴸ D) ≅ ev_n(B) ⊗ᴸ_R ev_n(D). It is the unique natural isomorphism whose inverse, composed with evaluation of the localization tensor counit, equals the pointwise identity tensor comparison conjugated by the exact-functor localization comparisons. This equation is imposed on every pair of homotopy complexes and in particular fixes the map, including its sign, on K-flat representatives. Define the comparison by this unique characterization, with no independent choice of a level automorphism. Use the small-Hom point localization fixed by [def-coef-tower-currying-models].
